SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE bracelet only, lying on the top face in a relaxed curve, the drops facing up, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it is a crop of the supplier photo: the bracelet lies on white with a pink code label in the middle and parts of a matching necklace at the edges: take ONLY the bracelet; ignore the label and the necklace at the edges. IMAGE 2 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A COLOURED STATION BRACELET with EXACTLY SEVEN small faceted stones, each in its own thin polished gold bezel, on a fine gold cable chain, ALTERNATING between stones set IN the chain and stones HANGING below it. In order from one end: a pale green ROUND stone set in the chain; a lilac CUSHION stone hanging as a drop; a yellow ROUND stone set in the chain; a pink PEAR stone hanging as a drop, point up; a blue ROUND stone set in the chain; a pale green OVAL stone hanging as a drop; a purple ROUND stone set in the chain. The stretch of chain on either side of the lobster clasp, about a third of the bracelet, is PLAIN chain with no stones at all; a short extender chain hangs from the clasp. Exactly seven stones in total, four set in the chain and three hanging, never eight or more, never two drops side by side; the plain stretch by the clasp carries no stone; mixed pastel colours only, no clear stones, no pearls, no clusters; one fine chain.

SCALE TEST: Each stone is about 5mm, smaller than a fingernail; they sit about 2cm apart; the chain is fine; the bracelet is about 17cm long with the extender. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.

SHOT: A tight beauty close-up of the ear and the jaw line, the camera brought close so every stone on the earring is countable. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: the ear, the jaw, the cheek below the nose, the neck, the collarbone and the shoulder. A cropped beauty detail, NOT a portrait.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; they hang on a black velvet T-shaped stand in a shop: ignore the stand, the hand and the bracelets behind. IMAGE 2 is our approved packshot of this exact piece: the authority on its size, proportions, metal colour and finish; the piece in this picture must match it exactly. IMAGE 3 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn in the earlobe: EXACTLY ONE earring in this ear, through a single piercing, never two earrings stacked on the same ear; any other jewellery in IMAGE 3 is removed.
